scope: Pure managed-bus TUSB320LAI source observation and explicit disabled-policy interrupt acknowledgement

hardware_contract.external_ilim_logic: Not implemented or validated by this driver

api_contract.poll: Read-only; sticky interrupt is never automatically acknowledged.
api_contract.initialize_disabled_policy: Caller must hold ILIM permission LOW; changes only accessory-disable bit without W1C.
api_contract.acknowledge_change: Caller must hold ILIM permission LOW; masked W1C plus current source/generation/readback verification.
api_contract.meaning_of_default_zero: No numeric current permission inferred without USB/BC1.2 power policy.

pending: Root power-policy and shared-bus integration; independent hardware permission/latch assessment.
Actual CC controller, cable/receptacle, dead-battery, source change, stuck-GPIO and I2C fault tests.
BC1.2 detection and any charging enable must be implemented and qualified separately.
